entities.summary: Uyunid, a notable figure in the history of Bahrain, associated with Uyunid and Usfurid Dynasties (1058–1253). Preceded by Uyunid Dynasty. Their legacy influenced Usfurid and Jabrid Dynasties and Usfurid Bedouin.
